function.arguments: {"observation": "The question asks for the number of patients enrolled, but excluding rows with `biomarker_baseline == -999` may remove patients who were enrolled but had no valid baseline measurement. This risks undercounting the true number of enrolled patients.", "implication": "To answer the question accurately, we must count all patients who were enrolled, regardless of whether their biomarker data is valid. function.name: note_finding
